with o as (select kalshi_order_id, market_ticker, strategy, quantity oq, limit_price lp, created_at from live_orders where strategy in ('Fmmsell10','Hmmsell10','Jmmsell10') and action='buy' and created_at >= '2026-10-01T00:00:00Z'),
f as (select o.market_ticker, min(o.strategy) tag, max(o.oq) oq, sum(f.quantity) fq, max(o.lp) lp from fills f join o using(kalshi_order_id) group by 1),
nw as (select distinct on (p.market_ticker) p.market_ticker, p.realized_pnl r, coalesce(p.quantity_fp,p.quantity::numeric) q from positions p join f using(market_ticker) order by p.market_ticker, p.captured_at desc)
select f.market_ticker, f.tag, f.oq, f.fq, f.lp, round(nw.r,4) r, nw.q from f join nw using(market_ticker) order by 1
